method.pairOrder: AB on odd formal pairs, BA on even pairs; declared warmup AB.
method.operationOrder: Rotate power/rarity/level, rarity/level/power, level/power/rarity across formal rounds; selector then center on odd rounds, center then selector on even rounds. Both versions get the same order in each pair; warmup uses power/rarity/level, selector then center.
method.moduleIdentity: Exact canonical src/inventory-query.js, src/views.js and src/storage.js URLs, already requested by the loaded application; dynamic import reuses the browser module map. No copied, transformed or query-suffixed function body.
method.state: Separate production-decodeSave snapshot of the exact synthetic save also loaded by the real app. Not a handle to the private app state. All original item references and the complete decoded state are checked outside timing.
method.setup: One real Continue then one real Inventory click per version/fixture verifies the visible first 60 IDs and full card DOM. This setup warms the application power path before the explicitly recorded warmup pair. Two rAF callbacks settle each version sequence outside all timed intervals.
method.boundary: performance.now immediately around exactly one selectInventoryItems(items,ui) or center(state,ui) synchronous call in the page. No DOM insertion, getter instrumentation, serialization, hashing, assertions or await inside the interval.
method.interpretation: Synchronous JavaScript elapsed time, including any GC or host preemption during the call; not OS thread CPU time, event-to-frame latency, paint, FPS or physical-device/GPU performance.
method.nesting: center includes its own selector call, safe-salvage analysis and first-60-card HTML construction. The separately measured phases are not additive, and their subtraction is not a measured render-only interval.
method.allocation: Normal production allocation is retained. Exact-result/state checks outside the interval also allocate and may influence later GC; no forced GC, object getters or manual JIT controls are used.
method.sampling: Fixed 12 pairs plus one warmup, all samples retained, no retry, adaptive rounds, outlier removal or stopping on a favorable result. --smoke is one separate pair and is never pooled. Small single-call samples may be timer-quantized.
method.quantiles: p50 is middle-two mean; p95 is nearest rank ceil(n*.95), hence max for n=12.
method.evidence: Complete selection order/original references, exact own-source center HTML, in-memory full state and UI settings, and both original stored strings checked every measured call. Report contains hashes and samples, never the full save or HTML.

browserConfiguration.rendering: ANGLE SwiftShader software rendering, matching the original UI protocol.
